meta.source: Traced from Lewis Brewer's reference map 2235.12.10; 1 unit = 1 light year; Sol at origin.

captions.text: The Sun's planets are settled. Luna and Mars become the first worlds beyond Earth.
Humanity spreads through the Sun's system. No ship has yet crossed to another star.
The Solar War divides the Sun's worlds.
Unification. The Sun's worlds move toward a single government.
The United Nations of Earth is founded and commits to the stars.
The Expansion Era. Four survey ships chart 800 stars; the core worlds are founded.
Contact with the Voor. The Ciriban Gulf becomes a border of trade and forts.
The Voor War. The Republic's fleets drive into the Confederacy.
The First Republic. Second and Third Waves settle the frontier; the Voor Territories join.
The Red Khan unites the Veil and conquers the Dwaii, the Ka-Dur and the Confederacy.
The Fevarian Crisis. The Khan takes the Gulf and both Sectors.
The Darkest Decade. The Khanate strikes into the core and reaches the Sun.
The Scouring. The Retribution Fleet destroys the monoliths outside the Veil.
Reconstruction. The Second Republic rebuilds the burned worlds.
The Apportionment Crisis. Chamber seats are recalculated for the first time since 2420.
